items.title: 21.4 Examples of Reactions of Halogenoalkanes (halogenoalkanes ke reactions ki misalein) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 21.4 with Quick Check 21.3, printed pages 79-81.

blocks.text: I. With Sodium Hydroxide (sodium hydroxide ke saath)

Halogenoalkane aqueous (pani wale) sodium hydroxide se react kar ke, reaction conditions (halaat) ke mutabiq, substitution aur elimination dono products deta hai. Hydroxide ion (OH⁻) achha nucleophile bhi hai aur achha base bhi. Jab yeh nucleophile ban kar attack karta hai to halogen ki jagah le leta hai aur substitution product, alcohol, banta hai. Jab yeh base ka kaam karta hai to β-hydrogen aur halogen dono ko hata deta hai aur elimination product, alkene, banti hai. Reaction zyada temperature par reflux (bhaap ko thanda kar ke wapas flask mein girane) ke saath kiya jata hai taake volatile (urne wale) products zaya na hon. Bromoethane aqueous sodium hydroxide se ethanol bhi deta hai aur ethene bhi.

blocks.alt: Displayed (sab bonds wala) bromoethane + NaOH, arrow ke oopar 'aqueous' (pani wala), se displayed ethanol + NaBr.
blocks.caption: Substitution reaction: bromoethane aur aqueous sodium hydroxide (kitab ke PDF page 82 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.alt: Displayed bromoethane + NaOH, arrow ke oopar 'alcohol', se displayed ethene + HOH + NaBr.
blocks.caption: Elimination reaction: bromoethane aur alcohol mein sodium hydroxide (kitab ke PDF page 82 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: paani (aqueous) mein OH⁻ zyada tar nucleophile ban kar alcohol deta hai; alcohol (ethanol) mein OH⁻ zyada tar base ban kar alkene deta hai.
